description: Migrate all dashboards from source to target.

action.description: Conflict strategy applied to every dashboard.

description: Migrate specific dashboards from source to target.

dashboard_ids.description: Dashboard OIDs to migrate. Provide either this or ``dashboard_names``.

dashboard_names.description: Dashboard titles to migrate. Provide either this or ``dashboard_ids``.

action.description: Conflict strategy when a dashboard with the same ``oid`` already exists on the target. - ``"skip"`` — leave the existing dashboard unchanged. - ``"overwrite"`` — replace the existing dashboard with the source version. - ``"duplicate"`` — always create, regardless of conflicts.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of dashboards to migrate concurrently, run via a background thread pool (``asyncio.to_thread``) since the underlying HTTP client is synchronous. Dashboards are independent of each other, so any value is safe. Values <= 1 (the default) process dashboards one at a time.

emit.description: Optional progress callback. Each invocation receives a dict with at least ``type``, ``step``, and ``message`` keys. When ``concurrency`` is greater than 1, this callback may be invoked from multiple worker threads concurrently.
